WidgetDesign.title: WidgetDesign
WidgetDesign.description: Custom AI-generated Android home screen widget configuration synced across user devices.

title.description: Widget title or header text (1-80 chars).

subtitle.description: Secondary subtitle or live metric label (0-120 chars).

primaryValue.description: Main display value such as time, temperature, battery, or stat (1-60 chars).

secondaryValue.description: Secondary badge or contextual info (0-80 chars).

prompt.description: User prompt that generated this widget (1-500 chars).

blurRadiusDp.description: Backdrop glass blur intensity in dp (0.0 to 40.0).

specularIntensity.description: Liquid glass rim reflection intensity (0.0 to 1.0).

cornerRadiusDp.description: Outer shape corner radius in dp (8.0 to 48.0).

iconName.description: Material icon identifier or 'CUSTOM' for imported user icon.

customIconBase64.description: Optional compressed Base64 data URI of an imported custom icon.

dataSourceType.description: External app or live system data provider feeding this widget.

sourcePackageHint.description: Target Android package or app name for data sync and optional tap action (0-120 chars).

tapBehavior.description: Action on widget tap (never opens AuraWidget AI).

isAnimated.description: Whether the widget runs live animations and real-time clock/ticking updates.

animationStyle.description: Visual animation style for both preview and home screen widget.

fontFamily.description: Custom font family used to render widget typography.

showForecast3Day.description: Whether to display expanded 3-day weather forecast on the widget.

locationName.description: Geographical location name or city for real weather (0-80 chars).

forecastJson.description: Serialized 3-day forecast JSON data for real weather display (0-5000 chars).

autoDarkAdapt.description: Whether widget automatically adapts contrast and tint for dark mode.

isPinned.description: Whether the widget is pinned to the active home screen preview and Android launcher.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: Cloud-synced user preferences, active wallpaper palette, and theme settings across devices.

activeWallpaperPreset.description: Selected wallpaper preset for color extraction and live preview.

extractedPaletteHex.description: List of up to 6 hex colors extracted from the user's wallpaper.

darkThemeMode.description: App and widget dark mode behavior synced across devices.

globalGlassOpacity.description: Default transparency level for widgets (0.05 to 1.0).

globalBlurDp.description: Default backdrop blur radius in dp (0.0 to 40.0).

syncDeviceName.description: Name of the last Android device that synced settings.

updatedAt.description: Last sync server timestamp via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/widgets/{widgetId}.description: Per-user collection of AI-generated widgets and custom styling configurations.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: Per-user cloud-synced workspace settings, wallpaper palette, and theme preferences.
